label: EVENT_LOGIC_V3_D0_FREEZE
motivation: FM2 — HURDLE final takeoff detection failure. V3-C0 accepts the first neg->non-neg velocity crossing after guard as the hurdle apex unconditionally. When D5 switches targets (dive 2169: cy 0.26->0.71 at 6.406s) the smoothed arc produces a false crossing where cy_apex >> y_prep (diver appears physically below the board at the apex). V3-D0 adds a board-rise invariant gate and a STANDING-like fallback.

D0_hurdle_apex_validity_gate.description: At every neg->non-neg velocity crossing after guard_end, check that cy_smooth at the apex frame is strictly above board level: cy_apex < y_prep - min_hurdle_rise_cy. If violated, the crossing is a detector artifact, not a real hurdle jump. Continue scanning. This is a physical necessity: a true hurdle apex requires the diver to have risen above the board.
D0_hurdle_apex_validity_gate.authority: DEVELOPMENT corpus (dive 2169 false apex: cy_apex=0.446 > y_prep=0.264; rise=-0.182 < 0.01 -> rejected)

D0_standing_fallback.description: If NO valid hurdle apex is found after exhaustive scan, fall back to STANDING-like departure: find first sustained negative velocity from guard_end. Rationale: if the hurdle is below 360p noise floor, a conservative estimate from guard_end is more accurate than accepting a mis-identified post-water-contact arc.
D0_standing_fallback.authority: DEVELOPMENT corpus (dive 2169 fallback to_err: 0.412s vs V3-C0 1.280s)

unchanged_from_v3_c0: No GT event-time windows fed to inference

perception_identity.signal_primitive: cy_norm (bbox center-y normalized by frame height)

state_semantics.prep_end: end of pre-takeoff plateau (last stable board position)
state_semantics.hurdle_apex: first neg->non-neg velocity crossing after guard with cy_apex < y_prep - min_rise; board-rise validated
state_semantics.board_recontact: first frame of descent after hurdle apex (implicit; search origin for final takeoff)
state_semantics.final_takeoff: first sustained negative velocity after board_recontact (or from guard_end if fallback)
state_semantics.apex: first neg->non-neg after takeoff+apex_search_start_s, or min cy in bounded window (A1)
state_semantics.water_contact: conf drop + sustained positive velocity after apex, bounded (A2)

pts_authority: PTS_EQUIVALENT (360p proxies share PTS timestamps with HQ originals)

1040.note: Signal irrecoverable at 360p (target oscillation cy=0.22<->0.60). False apex at 1.635s passes rise check (y_prep=0.531, cy_apex=0.221, rise=0.310 > 0.01).

2169.note: All 12 crossing candidates rejected (all cy_apex > y_prep=0.264). Fallback finds sustained negative velocity at 6.873s. Improvement is real though approximate: actual signal unrecoverable at 360p, fallback detects artifact-decay departure ~412ms after GT.

hq_authority.2169_hq_result: HQ_NO_MATERIAL_INCREMENT on signal metric; V3-C0 HQ to_err=0.439s
hq_authority.note: HQ used for observability analysis only; no HQ-derived parameters in V3-D0

paris_external_test.note: Paris has a pre-hurdle kinematic feature at 1.117s (y_prep=0.4635, cy_apex=0.380, rise=0.083 > min_rise) that passes the board-rise check and creates a false takeoff at 1.435s. This is a different failure mode from 2169 (Paris false apex rises above board, while 2169 false apex was below board).

scene_context_rationale: Paris has pre-hurdle prep-walk dynamics that pass the board-rise check (diver does briefly rise during the approach walk). Kinematic signals at 360p cannot distinguish the actual hurdle from false prep-walk patterns without scene context (approach-end constraint or board-proximity gating).

coverage: D0c: multiple false candidates, valid one accepted
D0d: fallback triggered when no valid apex
D0e: fallback finds sustained departure (2169 scenario)
